summary: Completed comprehensive testing of PriceIQ SaaS application. Backend APIs working correctly with proper authentication. Frontend UI fully functional with excellent responsive design and OAuth integration.

auth_limitations.issue: Full authentication testing requires real Emergent session_id from live OAuth flow

design_issues.note: Excellent UI component implementation - no issues found
